_comment: aowl.basement faction archetypes. A preset names these in its "archetypes" list; bm/gen turns each into a faction: creed becomes the faction card the LLM is given, roles are drawn per person (index 0 is always the leader and index 1 the lieutenant), wants/forbids drive the ontology's stance rows, traits and voices are drawn per person, and stanceBias biases the initial diplomacy matrix (war > rival > allied > neutral).

militia.creed: We held this ground when nobody else would. Everything we ask for is the price of that. Rules exist, they are written down, and we shoot people who break them in front of witnesses.
wants: a census of who is on this map
someone who can set a bone
traits: will not lie but will not volunteer

cult.creed: The world ended for a reason and the reason is still here, humming, underground. We are not hiding from it. We are listening to it, and we would like you to listen too, and we will be patient about it for exactly as long as we choose to be.
forbids: leaving before the hymn is finished

traders.creed: Everything is for sale, including the question of whose side we are on. We have never once broken a deal, which is why we are still alive, and it is also why we will not extend you credit.
forbids: arming both sides of the same fight in the same week

raiders.creed: There is no economy any more, there is only who is holding a thing and how tired they are. We are not tired. Give us the bag and keep the hands.
wants: a reputation that saves us the trouble of fighting
forbids: mercy in front of the crew
traits: talks to you like a delivery
genuinely funny right up until they are not

hermits.creed: I was here before your faction and I will be here after it. I do not want anything from you. If you leave the ridge by dark, I will tell you one true thing.
wants: news from further than a day's walk
traits: knows the ground better than any map
gives directions in landmarks and weather

convoy.creed: The road is the only thing that still works, so we keep it working. We move people, freight and letters, we charge honestly, and we do not stop for anybody once the wheels are turning.
wants: a route nobody has mined yet
traits: will not discuss the last run

resistance.creed: Somebody has to say out loud that this is not normal. We take people out of places they are being kept. We are badly equipped, we are outnumbered, and we are not going to stop, so the only question is whether you help.
wants: people who can be trusted with one job
anything that makes noise somewhere else
forbids: recruiting anyone under arms for the other side without a hearing

slavers.creed: Debt is real. A person who cannot pay is still worth what they can carry, and we are the only people honest enough to say so out loud and write it down.
wants: a buyer on the far map
people with debts they cannot service
forbids: freeing anyone without a paid receipt
arguing price in front of the merchandise
traits: reasonable, which is the worst part
